name: STAC Accuracy Extension Ontology
title: Definitions for STAC Accuracy extension elements
description: Vocabulary defining the elements of the STAC Accuracy extension (accuracy:geometric_x_bias, accuracy:geometric_y_bias, accuracy:geometric_x_stddev, accuracy:geometric_y_stddev, accuracy:geometric_rmse, accuracy:measurement_relative and accuracy:measurement_absolute), providing Linked Data terms for the STAC Accuracy schema. Reuses STAC core classes rather than redefining them. No enumerated values are defined by the extension, so this block has no SKOS component.
